summary.headline: Jupiter–Mars Planetary Combinations
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Jupiter–Mars–Mercury and Jupiter–Mars–Venus combinations, describing military, civic, priestly, athletic, managerial, social, and marital outcomes, along with misfortune, accusations, betrayals, and separations. A footnote cites King Antiochus’s horoscope and works by Puchstein and Bouché-Leclercq.
